description: The sheet number printed at the top right after the word 'Full', exactly as printed (e.g. 'Full 2' -> '2'). Read it, never compute it from the order of the pages. Empty if there is none.
The row number printed in the first column ('Núm.'), as printed (e.g. '17' -> 17). The numbering runs on from one sheet to the next; copy it, never renumber the rows or compute a number.

The surnames in the column 'Cognoms', exactly as written, with accents and the middle dot of l·l (e.g. 'Ul·ldemolins Casals'). A ditto mark is copied as written (e.g. 'id.' -> 'id.'); never replace it with the surname above.
The first name in the column 'Nom', exactly as written, keeping accents and old spellings (e.g. 'Joseph' -> 'Joseph', never 'Josep').
The age in years in the column 'Edat', as written (e.g. '38' -> 38). Copy it; never estimate or compute an age.
The letter in the column 'Sexe': H (home, man) or D (dona, woman). Copy the letter; never infer it from the first name.
The letter in the column 'Estat civil': S (solter, single), C (casat, married) or V (vidu, widowed). Copy the letter; never infer it from the age or the household.
The occupation in the column 'Professió', exactly as written (e.g. 'feines de casa', 'pagès'), ditto marks 'id.' included. Empty if the cell is blank; never fill in an occupation that is not written.
The column 'Sap llegir' (can read): 'S' -> yes, 'N' -> no. Empty if the cell is blank; never infer it from the age or the occupation.
